build_MiMoProcessor: build a MiMoProcessor instance with custom tokenizer and vision audio token IDs for multimodal processing
build_MiMoV2Processor: build a MiMoV2Processor from hf_config and server_args to handle image video and audio inputs
process_MiMoProcessor_process: process a list of Content items with text image video and audio into a MiMoInputSample
process_MiMoV2Processor_process_mm_data: process multimodal data with images videos and audios into input_ids and grid tensors for the model
process_MiMoProcessor_preprocess_audio: preprocess an audio file string or bytes into a mel spectrogram tensor and token length
